privacy.account.body: An account stores an email address, name, username, avatar, registration date and sign-in records. Passwords are stored as hashes. Signing in or connecting through Yandex involves the account ID, login, available email and access tokens. Connecting Disk permits access to selected photo sources.
privacy.account.title: Data stored by the website
privacy.account.trips: Trips store titles, descriptions, destinations, dates, participants and their access periods, journal entries, replies, favorites and photo titles. The service indexes photo and video information, including paths, capture dates and available GPS coordinates. Originals remain on Yandex Disk; previews and files may be transferred and cached for viewing. Your private list of followed trips is also stored.
privacy.bot.body: The bot receives the text, captions, photos, videos, documents and voice messages you send, your Telegram ID and message metadata. The database stores feedback content, its date, Telegram file references and a hash of the sender ID for spam limits. Feedback files are not downloaded to the application server. The chat ID is used in an encrypted queue to deliver a response. Feedback is accessible to the project administrator.
privacy.bot.registrations: The administrator may also receive new website users’ email addresses and view recent registration emails. Ordinary bot users cannot access this information. Do not include passwords, verification codes or information you do not wish to share with the administrator in your feedback.
privacy.bot.title: Telegram feedback
privacy.browser.body: Cookies support sign-in, authorization callbacks and invitations. A sign-in session lasts up to 30 days unless you sign out earlier. Local storage keeps language, theme and interface preferences; the browser may also cache accessible previews. You can clear this data in your browser settings. An intent to follow a guest trip may be stored in an HttpOnly cookie for up to 24 hours so the action can continue after sign-in.
privacy.browser.title: Cookies and browser storage
privacy.changes: This page will be updated when data handling changes. The Russian and English versions describe the same practices.
privacy.intro: How QuestKeeps handles data on the website and in the Telegram feedback bot. Both language versions are available below without an account.
privacy.providers.body: Yandex provides sign-in and Disk access. Resend receives the recipient address and transactional email content, including the verification link. Telegram processes bot messages and administrator notifications. When maps or external illustrations are displayed, the browser may contact map and image providers, including Esri, OpenStreetMap and Wikimedia, which receive the IP address and request parameters.
privacy.providers.places: Place discovery uses OpenStreetMap, Overpass and Wikipedia/Wikimedia data. Geographic lookups send coordinates or search areas; photos and Disk tokens are not sent to place discovery providers. External providers also process data under their own policies.
privacy.providers.title: External services
privacy.requests.body: To request access, correction or deletion of your data, contact the feedback bot. For feedback, provide its date and the beginning of its text; for an account, provide the email address or username. Account ownership may need to be verified to prevent deletion of someone else’s data. Do not send your password. There is currently no automatic account deletion button; an administrator handles the request.
privacy.requests.title: Questions and requests
privacy.retention.body: Accounts and trip content are retained to operate the service until deleted or a deletion request is handled. OAuth tokens, feedback content and sensitive outgoing queues are encrypted. Other database records and backups may also contain personal data; the service does not provide end-to-end encryption of all data.
privacy.retention.bot: After an administrator processes feedback, its content and stored attachment references are removed from the active database. Copies may remain in backups until deleted under the applicable retention procedures. Database deletion does not remove your original Telegram conversation; Telegram may also restrict a bot’s ability to delete old messages.
privacy.retention.title: Retention and protection
privacy.scope.body: QuestKeeps is a service for travel stories. The QuestKeeps project team operates the website and feedback bot. This policy describes the current service features. Questions about data handling can be sent through the Telegram bot linked at the end of this page.
privacy.scope.title: About this project and policy
privacy.sharing.body: A public profile shows the name, username and avatar. Friend lists and requests are visible to the account owner. Friendship alone does not grant trip access. The owner assigns participation dates and grants access either within those dates or to the whole trip. Your participation days are marked separately. An in-app invitation stores its sender, trip, dates, access settings and expiry; access begins only after acceptance. Users can be found by username or exact full email address; search results do not display email addresses. A guest link opens the published part of a trip to anyone who has it; media hidden from guests is excluded. Revoking a link does not remove previously downloaded copies. Following saves a trip to your archive without granting participant permissions. Revoking or replacing the guest link ends access through the follow.
privacy.sharing.title: Who can see your stories
privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.use.body: Data supports registration and sign-in, email verification, synchronization of selected sources, gallery and map display, nearby place discovery, shared trips, feedback handling and abuse prevention. Technical logs may contain an IP address, request time, page path and error information.
privacy.use.title: How data is used
